decisions.reason: The d=0 case was omitted from the root-bound proof, although its conclusion is immediate because the characteristic polynomial is 1 and every disk count is zero. Added that case before assuming d>=1 and restricted F2 to positive degree. For positive degree the coefficient root bound, canonical finite root lists, coordinate subsequence extraction, unique limiting factorization and boundary exclusion establish the stated multiplicity counts. The claim and all interfaces are unchanged; this is a readily closed boundary omission, not a false cluster theorem.

F3 was phrased for an arbitrary norm although its supplier proves a Euclidean inequality. The Jordan-adapted contraction argument is valid after the routine norm-equivalence transfer: apply F3 to R=P-Ax with Euclidean derivative bound epsilon, then obtain adapted Lipschitz bound (C/c)epsilon and choose q+(C/c)epsilon<1. Added that transfer, the trivial m=0 case, and the fixed-neighborhood escape formulation of Lyapunov instability. The stable/unstable cone inequalities require only the differentiability remainder R=o(norm x). The original stability claim is unchanged.

The proof already assumes E complete and never needs the cited theorem to extend to dimension zero or to arbitrary norms. Its F2 restatement nevertheless exceeded the supplied R and R^n, n>=1 interface. Corrected that scope and made the pointwise-limit step cite the given completeness hypothesis. The explicit weighted isometry onto C_b, uniform Cauchy estimate, bounded continuous limit and uniqueness of pointwise limits prove completeness, including E={0}, without choice. No Statement changed.

The title identified the real number ell_1 with the generally complex resonant coefficient G21/2. Retitled it as the frequency-normalized radial cubic coefficient, matching Re(G21)/2=omega_0 ell_1 exactly. Checked the degree-two embedding equations, invertibility of A and 2i omega_0 I-A, and projection of the w^2 conjugate(w) invariance equation: they give h11=-A^-1 B(q,conjugate(q)), h20=(2i omega_0 I-A)^-1 B(q,q), and the stated G21 with its 1/2 factor. The proof also constructs C2 parameter-dependent homological changes; the Statement and its remainder bounds are unchanged.

F1 omitted the equation regularity hypothesis and advertised C5 output even when used on G, which step 1.2 proves only C4. Restated the actual Ck theorem and specified k=4 in both G=0 applications. The integral factorization F=xG gives Gx=Fxx/2 and Gxx=Fxxx/3, so the nonzero solved derivatives license both branches with the needed regularity. The scalar fold supplier has n=1, v=w=1 and x(s)=s; nonzero curvature and IVT give its exact level counts. Evenness gives the pitchfork pair. No claimed branch or hypothesis was weakened.

The rejection overlooks the actual supplier proof: lem-hopf-first-lyapunov-coefficient-from-multilinear-data step 5.1 explicitly constructs homological coordinate changes with at least C2 parameter dependence. Its steps 1.2 and 2.1 give finite polynomial changes with nonvanishing divisors; C5 center data provide the mixed derivatives of their quadratic and cubic coefficients. Their inverses and transformed field are jointly C1, and polar substitution and division by positive angular speed preserve C1 on r>0. Thus the augmented radial flow and punctured-side C1 IFT are licensed. Checked the return-map sign, annular uniqueness, multiplier expansions and hyperbolic section classification. Consulted Kuznetsov section 3.5, complete Lemmas 3.4-3.6, printed pp.94-97, on these parameter-dependent transformations. No item edit is needed.

Procedure step 3 of alg-validate-local-hopf-certificate explicitly requires the noncritical real-part rectangles each to exclude zero and returns inconclusive if this is unproved. Together with the exact multiplicity cover and simple critical-root witnesses, this puts every noncritical eigenvalue off the imaginary axis; F1 refers to acceptance of the complete algorithm, not solely to enumeration. The tied root, jets, branch derivative and inverse witnesses identify the same equilibrium, and the strict crossing and Lyapunov intervals exclude zero. Translation matches the local theorem hypotheses and its local-only conclusions. The rejected step is sound; no edit is warranted.

F2 suppressed the simple-pair, spectral-exclusion, smooth-field and branch hypotheses of the Hopf theorem, although verification step 1.1 establishes them for this polynomial planar field. Restated all those hypotheses without changing the example. Direct calculation with q=p=(1,-i)/sqrt(2) gives q dot q=0, q dot conjugate(q)=1, C(q,q,conjugate(q))=-4q, G21=-4 and ell_1=-2. The exact polar equations give R=sqrt(mu) on mu>0, period 2pi and radial derivative -2mu. Thus the example and its claimed stability are sound; the defect was a nonfatal truncated restatement.
